tools.name: journal_get_board
tools.title: Read Journal Board
tools.description: Read a KST weekly board. The current week includes latest unfinished work from earlier weeks without closing them. Closed weeks include the frozen closure candidates, current reflectionStatus, and appended corrections. Reads never modify storage.

weekId.description: KST Monday date; omit for the current week

tools.name: journal_ingest_items
tools.title: Ingest Journal Observations
tools.description: Idempotently create or refresh concise work observations. This never changes resolution.

tools.name: journal_find_items
tools.title: Find Journal Items
tools.description: Find Journal items by week or date range, text, project, lane, and resolution.

tools.name: journal_get_item_history
tools.title: Read Journal Item History
tools.description: Read one item, its weekly instances, source references, state history, and corrections.

tools.name: journal_set_resolution
tools.title: Confirm Journal Item Resolution
tools.description: Confirm an item as active, held, completed, or canceled after the owner has decided.

tools.name: journal_prepare_week_close
tools.title: Prepare Journal Week Close
tools.description: Preview the frozen summary, rollover items, and explicit Corpus reflection candidates without closing the week.

tools.name: journal_confirm_week_close
tools.title: Confirm Journal Week Close
tools.description: Close the prepared KST week only when the owner explicitly requests it. Pending or failed Corpus candidates do not block close and remain available for later reflection; this never marks them applied or skipped.

tools.name: journal_add_correction
tools.title: Add Closed-week Correction
tools.description: Append a correction note to a closed week without rewriting its frozen items.

tools.name: journal_get_period
tools.title: Read Journal Period
tools.description: Read daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly Journal totals and project rollups.

tools.name: journal_record_corpus_promotion
tools.title: Record Corpus Reflection
tools.description: Record a verified Corpus reflection outcome before or after week close for an existing project-relative source. After close, itemId, targetSpace, and contentHash must match a frozen candidate from journal_get_board; read its corrections before applying. Failed attempts are retained and do not complete a candidate. Re-send the same receipt request with the same idempotency key; use a new key for a new attempt after failure. Completed candidates are not overwritten. Read the Corpus target before retrying: this records receipts, not an external-write lock.

sourcePath.description: A project-root-relative Corpus Source or Work path, or a non-path receipt label; never a local absolute path.

tools.name: journal_save_period_summary
tools.title: Save Journal Period Summary
tools.description: Append an owner-edited summary version for a day, week, month, quarter, or year while preserving links to source events.

tools.name: host_capabilities
tools.title: Host capabilities
tools.description: Return the Host version and the shared size and time limits.

tools.name: host_roots
tools.title: List roots
tools.description: List the registered workspace roots on the host with their write permission, execution policy, and the Source roots each may read.

tools.name: host_search
tools.title: Search files
tools.description: Search file contents in a host root with a regular expression (ripgrep). paths are root-relative globs. Returns matching lines with context; truncated=true means a limit was hit.

tools.name: host_read
tools.title: Read files
tools.description: Read UTF-8 text files from a host root, optionally by line range. Returns each file's content and version; max_bytes caps the total returned content.

tools.name: host_write
tools.title: Write a file
tools.description: Create or replace a file in a host root (content), replace the text between two unique markers (replace), or delete a file (delete=true). A normal write needs only root, path and content. expected_version (from host_read, or "absent" for new files) rejects the write when the file changed.

tools.name: host_exec
tools.title: Run a command
tools.description: Run a command in a sandbox container on the host with the root mounted at /workspace. Give argv (preferred) or shell. Waits up to wait_s; if the job is still queued or running, poll host_job with the returned job_id.

tools.name: host_job
tools.title: Job status and output
tools.description: Return a host job's status and a slice of its stored stdout or stderr. offset is a byte position; use next_offset to continue; limit=0 returns status only. eof is true once the job finished and the output is fully read.

tools.name: host_job_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running host job. Finished jobs keep their status.
